description: For each case and each factor present: risk with that factor at reference, RR, and Shapley / first / last-position shares of the modelled risk difference on two scales
population: CRSS 2016-2024 drivers of light passenger vehicles (belt use belted/none/unknown); second model: drivers with known police drug status
method: Survey logistic model saturated in the grid factors (all products of their indicators), with environment/person covariates; g-computation standardised over the population; Taylor linearisation (42 df); cells with < 30 drivers or < 10 deaths withheld; Shapley allocations exact over the factors present
